name: sql-checkrpc
help: Toggle CLR, OLE, RPC or xp_cmdshell
long_help: Toggle on or off CLR, OLE, RPC or xp_cmdshell.  For rpc, valid values are TRUE or FALSE.  For all others, use 1 to enable or 0 to disable.

arguments.name: module
arguments.desc: Module to toggle. Valid choices are [rpc, clr enabled, xp_cmdshell, Ole Automation Procures]

arguments.name: value
arguments.desc: Value to use for toggle.  For rpc, valid choices are 'TRUE' or 'FALSE'.  For all others, either 1 or 0

arguments.name: link
arguments.desc: Optional: Execute query through linked server

arguments.name: impersonate
arguments.desc: Optional: User to impersonate during execution
